name: Torotoro Ricchi ~Nee-chan to Sono Tomodachi to Boku.~
original_name: とろとろりっち～姉ちゃんとその友達と僕。～
source:
Our mom was in the hospital for obstetric care.
Our dad was always working and never home.
My hot older sister Fumika and I basically had the run of the house.
And Fumika had a friend, a kind of slutty gal-type named Airi...

"Onechan...... I can't stand it any more!!" 

[From: [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE173418.html]DLsite English[/url]]
